devdoc.title: FanPass: prove you're a unique human ONCE, then join any event in seconds.

verify(uint256,uint256,(uint256,uint256,.notice: Is this a valid Fan Pass proof for `scope` (an event) and `message` (a wallet)?

userdoc.notice: - Enrol (once, heavy): an Anon Aadhaar proof whose signal is the fan's Fan Pass identity commitment.    One Aadhaar = one Fan Pass (tracked by the Aadhaar nullifier for this registry). The commitment is    added to a Semaphore group. Anyone may submit the enrolment (a kiosk or relayer pays the gas),    because the proof is bound to the commitment, not to the sender.  - Use (every event, light): a Semaphore proof "I'm in the group" whose scope is the event and whose    message is the fan's wallet. Semaphore's nullifier is unique per (person, event) and can't be linked    across events. Proving takes ~1-2 s on a phone (5 MB artifacts) instead of minutes (584 MB).  - Lost phone: re-enrol with the same Aadhaar. The old commitment is REMOVED from the group first, so    the old phone's pass stops working.
